scope: Allocated state handle ownership independent of public state aliases/replacements
invariants: original own state handles disposed once despite public aliases
external signals assigned into public state remain borrowed
replaced originally owned state still disposed
rollback releases actual allocated candidate rather than foreign replacement
closed instance prevents later rollback setter callbacks
tested teardown graph empty and external graph count preserved
testOracle: Disposer call counts plus live external values and graph totals; peek behavior is not treated as proof of disposal.
limitations: Direct state-map assignment is not a qualified reactive rebinding API.
Replacement semantics for other public resource maps remain open.
Custom disposer self-release, general accessor/proxy side effects and post-commit rollback are not qualified.
